tests.prompt: My application crashes when I click the login button. I am using Chrome on macOS.
tests.expected: A bug report is created successfully and the response contains a ticketId and status OPEN.

tests.prompt: How do I track my order?
tests.expected: Once the order ships, the customer receives a tracking link by email. Customers with an account can also find tracking under My Orders.

tests.prompt: I want to give feedback about your customer service.
tests.expected: The customer is politely directed to human customer support at 1-800-123-4567.
